policy: V25 makes remaining distributable-period profit fee-aware without double counting. OWNER_DISTRIBUTION principal continues to consume entitlement because it is excluded from P&L. OWNER_DISTRIBUTION_SETTLEMENT_FEE entries reduce the historical gross profit budget only when they are posted after the base StatementReplay closing sequence and are attributed to the same affected period; pre-close fee expense is already represented in the base realized P&L and must not be deducted again.

additions.authority_note: Ledger-derived remaining profit entitlement. Formula: fee_adjusted_period_profit_budget=max(0,gross_period_profit_budget-post_close_settlement_fee_expenses); remaining=max(0,fee_adjusted_period_profit_budget-net_consumed_distribution_budget). Binds exact base StatementReplay closing sequence to prevent fee double counting. No authorization/payment/execution/AI authority.
